newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens against dollar.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against the dollar but firmed against the pound on Thursday reflecting international market trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a commercial mean rate of 20.7675 to the dollar from 20.727 on Wednesday and at 34.578 to the pound from 34.608 on Wednesday.
Forex dealers said the rupee's performance against the dollar was also due to the central bank's non-intervention on the forex interbank market on Wednesday.
They added commercial banks faced a hard currency shortage and expected central bank intervention to sell dollars.
